name: antar-editorial-comparison-normalization
description: Comparison-only normalization rules. Never rewrite stored source Sanskrit.

rules.description: Normalize Unicode to NFC for comparison only.
Collapse horizontal whitespace runs and structural blank lines between pādas.
Remove spaces immediately before danda characters.
Normalize equivalent spacing immediately around danda characters for comparison only.
Separate verse marker from root textual content before comparing roots.
Approved orthographic equivalence: संजय ↔ सञ्जय (anusvara vs ñ cluster).

notes: Do not add broad Sanskrit spelling substitutions.
Original source forms must remain preserved in source-comparison evidence.
Normalized match is not scholarly approval.
